description: Add cards to a deck's list (its wantlist), or to the personal deck-independent wantlist when deck is omitted. Send the whole list in ONE call (max 75 items): it is resolved and written in one batch. section: main (default) or sideboard, per item or for the whole call; commander formats have no sideboard. By default a want accepts ANY printing of the card (oracle-level). Set pin:true with a specific printing to require exactly that printing. Duplicate adds merge quantities. Adding a card claims nothing: each added row comes back with its coverage from the collection — allocated, shared_in, claimable (free copies you own, not yet claimed), missing — and proxies_allocated. Relay shared_detail / also_shared_with and proxies as deck_status requires. Next step: claim_from_collection. lang per item: the language the row asks for (Scryfall's code: de, ja, zhs…), a preference that trading matches first.

deck.description: Deck id or name; omit for the personal wantlist

anyOf.description: Scryfall's language code: en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, ru, zhs, zht, …

lang.description: The language this row asks for; omitted, the deck's

name.description: Card name in English or any language Scryfall prints ("Blitzschlag", "Foudre", "稲妻"), used when scryfall_id is absent; an English name is also fuzzy-resolved via Scryfall

pin.description: Pin to the exact printing referenced

scryfall_id.description: Exact Scryfall printing id, if known

section.description: Section for every item without its own (default main)

name: add_wants
title: Add wants
